mapper.update: update exam_question set question_type = #{questionType}, question_stem = #{questionStem}, options_json = #{optionsJson}, correct_answer = #{correctAnswer}, answer_analysis = #{answerAnalysis}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}

update exam_paper set paper_name = #{paperName}, description = #{description}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, total_score = #{totalScore}, pass_score = #{passScore}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select ep.*, (select count(*) from exam_paper_question epq where epq.paper_id = ep.id) as question_count from exam_paper ep where ep.id = #{id}

select ep.*, (select count(*) from exam_paper_question epq where epq.paper_id = ep.id) as question_count from exam_paper ep
ep.paper_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and ep.status = #{status}
order by ep.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into exam_paper_question (paper_id, question_id, question_score, sort_num) values (#{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{questionScore}, #{sortNum})
mapper.select: select epq.*, eq.question_type, eq.question_stem, eq.options_json, eq.correct_answer, eq.answer_analysis from exam_paper_question epq join exam_question eq on eq.id = epq.question_id where epq.paper_id = #{paperId} order by epq.sort_num, epq.id
select count(*) from exam_schedule where paper_id = #{paperId}
mapper.update: update exam_schedule set paper_id = #{paperId}, class_id = #{classId}, exam_name = #{examName}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} where id = #{id}
update exam_schedule set answer_published = 1, answer_publish_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.sql: select es.*, ep.paper_name, ep.total_score, ep.duration_minutes, ec.class_term, (select count(*) from exam_attempt ea where ea.schedule_id = es.id) as attempt_count from exam_schedule es join exam_paper ep on ep.id = es.paper_id join edu_class ec on ec.id = es.class_id
mapper.select: select ea.*, es.exam_name, ep.total_score as paper_total_score from exam_attempt ea join exam_schedule es on es.id = ea.schedule_id join exam_paper ep on ep.id = es.paper_id where ea.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} order by ea.submit_time desc, ea.id desc
select ea.*, es.exam_name, ep.total_score as paper_total_score from exam_attempt ea join exam_schedule es on es.id = ea.schedule_id join exam_paper ep on ep.id = es.paper_id where ea.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into exam_attempt ( schedule_id, student_id, student_no, student_name_snapshot, start_time, status, objective_score, subjective_score, total_score ) values ( #{scheduleId}, #{studentId}, #{studentNo}, #{studentNameSnapshot}, #{startTime}, #{status}, 0, 0, 0 )

insert into exam_answer (attempt_id, paper_question_id, question_id) select #{attemptId}, epq.id, epq.question_id from exam_paper_question epq where epq.paper_id = #{paperId} order by epq.sort_num, epq.id
mapper.select: select ea.*, eq.question_type, eq.question_stem, eq.options_json, eq.correct_answer, eq.answer_analysis, epq.question_score, epq.sort_num from exam_answer ea join exam_question eq on eq.id = ea.question_id join exam_paper_question epq on epq.id = ea.paper_question_id where ea.attempt_id = #{attemptId} order by epq.sort_num, epq.id

select ea.*, eq.question_type, eq.question_stem, eq.options_json, eq.correct_answer, eq.answer_analysis, epq.question_score, epq.sort_num from exam_answer ea join exam_question eq on eq.id = ea.question_id join exam_paper_question epq on epq.id = ea.paper_question_id where ea.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update exam_answer set score = #{score}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_teacher_id = #{teacherId}, review_time = now() where id = #{id}
update exam_attempt set submit_time = now(), status = 'SUBMITTED', objective_score = #{objectiveScore}, total_score = #{objectiveScore} + subjective_score where id = #{id} and status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

update exam_attempt set objective_score = coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(answer.score, 0)) from exam_answer answer join exam_question question on question.id = answer.question_id where answer.attempt_id = exam_attempt.id and question.question_type in ('SINGLE', 'MULTIPLE', 'JUDGE') ), 0), subjective_score = coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(answer.score, 0)) from exam_answer answer join exam_question question on question.id = answer.question_id where answer.attempt_id = exam_attempt.id and question.question_type in ('FILL', 'SHORT') ), 0), total_score = coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(answer.score, 0)) from exam_answer answer where answer.attempt_id = exam_attempt.id ), 0) where id = #{id}
update exam_attempt set status = 'REVIEWED' where id = #{id} and status = 'SUBMITTED'
mapper.select: select es.*, ep.paper_name, ep.total_score, ep.duration_minutes, ec.class_term, ea.id as attempt_id, ea.status as attempt_status, ea.total_score as student_score from edu_student student join exam_schedule es on es.class_id = student.class_id join exam_paper ep on ep.id = es.paper_id join edu_class ec on ec.id = es.class_id left join exam_attempt ea on ea.schedule_id = es.id and ea.student_id = student.id where student.id = #{studentId} and es.status != 'CANCELLED' order by es.start_time desc, es.id desc
